description: Runs the seo_audit_page checks on the person's page and a competitor's page that targets the same search or task, and lists the checks where they differ. Use it when the person asks why a competitor ranks or shows up in AI answers and they do not. result has mine and theirs (status, scores, problem count, word count, headings, schema types) and differences (check id with each side's status and summary). These are deterministic checks of public pages fetched by Agent Ready Website Audit, with no AI model and no account. They do not cover rankings, keyword volumes, backlinks or how AI answers mention the brand. Returns JSON: summary (one sentence), reportUrl (a shareable report page for the person, kept 30 days; null for tools that keep none) and result (the details below). Errors come back as one plain sentence. Recorded: the checked domain and path (never the query string), the tool, which checks failed and the app name; never an IP address or page text.

competitorUrl.description: The competitor's page for the same search or task: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.

url.description: The person's own page: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.

name: compare_with_competitor_page
title: Compare with a competitor's page
